The domain of an honorific (academic, clerical, noble, military, judicial, social).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:HonorificClass`](gmeow-HonorificClass.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for the social/institutional domain an honorific is drawn from (academic, clerical, noble, military, judicial, social) — referenced from [`gmeow:honorificClass`](../properties/gmeow-honorificClass.md) on a [`gmeow:Honorific`](gmeow-Honorific.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a [`Honorific`](gmeow-Honorific.md) subclass per class (classes are individuals) and avoid using it for render placement — that is [`gmeow:HonorificPosition`](gmeow-HonorificPosition.md).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`HonorificClass`](gmeow-HonorificClass.md) individual from [`gmeow:honorificClass`](../properties/gmeow-honorificClass.md) on a [`Honorific`](gmeow-Honorific.md); extend with a new individual rather than a subclass when a new domain of address appears.

### Examples

- ex:honorific [`gmeow:honorificClass`](../properties/gmeow-honorificClass.md) [`gmeow:honorificClassAcademic`](../individuals/gmeow-honorificClassAcademic.md).
